name: Parameterized Algorithms for NP-hard Problems
description:
Review of NP-completeness and reductions. Introduction to parameterized complexity,
parameterized algorithms through bounded search trees, iterative compression,
randomized methods in parameterized algorithms, dynamic programming over subsets,
treewidth and parameterized algorithms for bounded treewidth graphs, algebraic
techniques in parameterized complexity, Matroids and representative sets, lower
bounds for parameterized algorithms based on Exponential Time Hypothesis and
Strong Exponential Time Hypothesis.
